current.question: Raise the compaction reserveTokens to 30000 for the opus model only, using a per-model override in my settings, and check that Pi actually applies it.
current.latest: Reading the settings manager to see how modelOverrides are resolved.

exchanges.label: relevant
exchanges.prompt: Where does Pi decide to auto-compact the context, and which thresholds or settings control it? Answer with file:line references.
exchanges.answer: Auto-compaction is decided by shouldCompact() in dist/core/compaction/compaction.js:168: it fires when contextTokens > contextWindow - reserveTokens. The settings are compaction.enabled (default true), compaction.reserveTokens (16384) and compaction.keepRecentTokens (20000), read in dist/core/settings-manager.js:597-636; per-model overrides live under compaction.modelOverrides.

exchanges.label: unrelated
exchanges.prompt: The TUI footer flickers whenever an extension updates its status text. Find out why.
exchanges.answer: The footer is re-rendered on every setStatus call because FooterComponent.invalidate() clears the whole line cache (dist/modes/interactive/components/footer.js:88). Throttling setStatus in the extension, or diffing before invalidate, removes the flicker.

exchanges.label: unrelated
exchanges.prompt: Which themes does Pi ship with, and how do I switch between them?
exchanges.answer: Pi ships dark and light themes (dist/modes/interactive/theme/*.json). Switch with /theme or set "theme" in ~/.pi/agent/settings.json; custom themes go in ~/.pi/agent/themes.

exchanges.label: relevant
exchanges.prompt: When a context_edit is present, how does Pi estimate contextTokens for the compaction threshold?
exchanges.answer: estimateProjectedContextTokens() in dist/core/compaction/compaction.js:61 rebuilds the projection with the edits applied and ignores usage captured before the latest edit, so the threshold check sees the edited size.
